title: fix(electron): keep wiki-link backlinks consistent after file changes
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Keep wiki-link backlinks consistent when files are added to or removed from the Electron demo vault.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

LinkIndex.updateFile() only rebuilt reverse edges originating from the changed file, while removeFile() only removed edges whose source was deleted. That is correct for content-only edits, but file additions and removals change the target candidate set globally.

This could leave stale backlinks after deleting a target, fail to resolve existing links after adding a target, and retain incorrect results when basename ambiguity changed.

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): existing wikilinks / note-vault behavior
- OpenSpec change: not required (bug fix)

## Changes / 变更内容

- Preserve incremental reverse-index updates for edits to existing files.
- Rebuild reverse edges after file additions or removals that change link-resolution topology.
- Add regression coverage for:
  - deleting a linked target;
  - adding a previously missing target;
  - removing one of two ambiguous basename targets;
  - adding a duplicate basename that makes a target ambiguous.
